title: FLOOD-X Spatial Flood Susceptibility Index (SFSI)
pilot_basin: Pune / Mula-Mutha River Basin, Maharashtra, India
methodology: Multi-Criteria Geomorphic AHP (River Proximity 40%, Slope 30%, Relative Elevation 30%). Zero Circular Target Weighting.

chronic_hotspots.name: Sinhagad Road (Ekta Nagari / Anand Nagar)
chronic_hotspots.description: Severely inundated in July 2024 (35,574 cfs discharge) and Aug 2019. Backwater pooling behind low river walls.
chronic_hotspots.action_guidance: Immediate evacuation readiness during dam releases > 15k cfs or cloudburst warnings (>50mm/h).

chronic_hotspots.name: Baba Bhide Bridge (Deccan Causeway)
chronic_hotspots.description: Low-level causeway submerged when Khadakwasla discharge exceeds 15,000 cusecs. Completely underwater July 2024.
chronic_hotspots.action_guidance: Immediate evacuation readiness during dam releases > 15k cfs or cloudburst warnings (>50mm/h).

chronic_hotspots.name: Pulachi Wadi (Deccan Gymkhana Riverside)
chronic_hotspots.description: Dense informal settlement on immediate riverbank, inundated at > 20,000 cusecs.
chronic_hotspots.action_guidance: Immediate evacuation readiness during dam releases > 15k cfs or cloudburst warnings (>50mm/h).

chronic_hotspots.name: Ambil Odha / Sahakar Nagar / Padmavati
chronic_hotspots.description: Channelized natural nullah breached in Sept 2019 cloudburst (>100mm in 3h), causing 24 fatalities.
chronic_hotspots.action_guidance: Immediate evacuation readiness during dam releases > 15k cfs or cloudburst warnings (>50mm/h).

chronic_hotspots.name: Sangam (Mula-Mutha Confluence)
chronic_hotspots.description: Hydrodynamic confluence backwater where Mula and Mutha merge; high hazard zone for Sangamwadi and Yerwada.
chronic_hotspots.action_guidance: Immediate evacuation readiness during dam releases > 15k cfs or cloudburst warnings (>50mm/h).

chronic_hotspots.name: PCMC Sangvi / Pavana-Mula Confluence
chronic_hotspots.description: Low-lying wards along Pavana riverbank subject to Pavana dam spill.
chronic_hotspots.action_guidance: Immediate evacuation readiness during dam releases > 15k cfs or cloudburst warnings (>50mm/h).

surface_canopy_bias_note: Copernicus GLO-90 DSM is a Digital Surface Model reflecting top-of-canopy and building roof elevations rather than bare-earth terrain (DTM). In dense Pune urban wards and riparian vegetation corridors along the Mula-Mutha, elevations may be biased upward by 2 to 8 meters, causing local relative elevations to appear higher (and slope slightly gentler) than actual ground level.
disclaimer: Geospatial susceptibility indicates physical terrain exposure and river proximity. It does not predict flood events without concurrent hydrological forcing and dam release telemetry.
